g.text: The accepted execution identity is already registered in the DB.
Its live Agent object and credentials remain on instance A.
lock and validate current target identity
append user.interrupt and persist stop intent
commit; complete receipt and fixed target
enqueue receipt before any result delivery
batch read stop intents for local active targets
pending stop for the fixed target
recheck identity and request local cancellation
recheck target; append one authoritative idle
link target to idle; update only matching state
original SSE: same committed idle; close
batch read terminal results for local waiting responses
project immutable response VO; retain eventId
B reads only the terminal result, not Agent output.
A may finish before B polls; the committed result remains readable.
No credential is stored in control records or polling queues.
Polling does not wait for the next token or tool response.
Recheck the fixed generation; never cancel a later execution.
Repeated checks must not repeat side effects or block the whole batch.
Timeout, DB failure or owner loss is not proof of successful interruption.
No automatic takeover or POST replay; reconcile authoritative history.
Polling interval, batch size and failure handling details remain open.
Redis is a future optional wake-up optimization, not a current dependency.
